name: Net Retention Cost Saved
formula: (TP x avg_replacement_cost x intervention_success_rate) - (flagged_total x intervention_cost)
interpretation: On this 2250-employee test set, correctly identifying 544 true leavers and successfully retaining 30% of them (after subtracting intervention cost for all 920 flagged employees) produces an estimated net saving of $10,742,210. This scales roughly linearly with headcount, so extrapolate to your full workforce size.

name: Flight Risk Recall
formula: TP / (TP + FN)  [of actual leavers, % correctly flagged]
interpretation: The model catches 74.8% of employees who actually leave. Slightly below the 0.75 target -- missed leavers (false negatives) are the costliest error type for this business problem, so this is the KPI to watch most closely.

name: Model F1 Score
interpretation: F1 of 0.6606 balances precision (0.5913) against recall (0.7483), confirming the model isn't achieving recall merely by flagging everyone as a flight risk.

name: Feature Completeness Rate
interpretation: 100.0% of required fields are populated across 15000 raw records (0 missing values found). Exceeds the 95% target comfortably -- source data is production-quality.

name: Counterfactual Simulation Latency
formula: avg wall-clock time per single what-if re-score (ms)
interpretation: Average of 50 runs: 8.19 ms per counterfactual query, well within the 500ms target -- fast enough for interactive use in the dashboard.
